controlChangeCommands.name: A Engine
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Selects and loads Delay (& Reverb) engines into side A. Factory default MIDI map (Collider MIDI Guide).

controlChangeCommands.name: A Time
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Sets min and max delay times (delay engines); meaning follows loaded A engine

controlChangeCommands.name: A Mix
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 50/50 point at approx. 95

controlChangeCommands.name: A Feedback
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Delay regeneration amount when A is a delay engine

controlChangeCommands.name: A Control 1
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Whatever parameter is assigned to CONTROL 1 for the loaded A engine (Neuro)

controlChangeCommands.name: A Control 2
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Whatever parameter is assigned to CONTROL 2 for the loaded A engine (Neuro)

controlChangeCommands.name: A Tap Div
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Delay side tap tempo beat division

controlChangeCommands.name: B Engine
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Selects and loads Reverb (& Delay) engines into side B. Factory default MIDI map (Collider MIDI Guide).

controlChangeCommands.name: B Time
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Sets Pre Delay of the Reverb when B is a reverb engine

controlChangeCommands.name: B Mix
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 50/50 point at approx. 95

controlChangeCommands.name: B Feedback
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Sets the decay rate of the Reverb when B is a reverb engine

controlChangeCommands.name: B Control 1
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Whatever parameter is assigned to CONTROL 1 for the loaded B engine (Neuro)

controlChangeCommands.name: B Control 2
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Whatever parameter is assigned to CONTROL 2 for the loaded B engine (Neuro)

controlChangeCommands.name: B Tap Div
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Reverb/B-side tap tempo beat division (relevant when B loads a delay engine)

controlChangeCommands.name: Stereo Div
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Official MIDI Guide lists both Delay (A) Stereo Division and Reverb (B) Stereo Division on CC 24 (0–5). Single CC entry required; division labels not named in the guide.

controlChangeCommands.name: Preset Down
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Any value

controlChangeCommands.name: Preset Up
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Any value

controlChangeCommands.name: Remote Tap
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Same as tapping the DELAY/TAP footswitch; any value

controlChangeCommands.name: Remote Hold
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Same as pressing the REVERB footswitch (hold when reverb engaged); any value

controlChangeCommands.name: Remote Expr
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Overrides all expression inputs

controlChangeCommands.name: A Bypass
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0–64 Bypass, 65–127 Engage

controlChangeCommands.name: A Bypass Tog
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Toggle Delay (A) Bypass/Engage; any value

controlChangeCommands.name: B Bypass
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0–64 Bypass, 65–127 Engage

controlChangeCommands.name: B Bypass Tog
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Toggle Reverb (B) Bypass/Engage; any value

controlChangeCommands.name: PC Both Off
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: CC value 0–127 selects preset (Neuro display 1–128); recalls with Delay(A) & Reverb(B) bypassed. Prefer Program Change when available.

controlChangeCommands.name: PC Dly On
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: CC value 0–127 selects preset; recalls with Delay(A) engaged. Prefer Program Change when available.

controlChangeCommands.name: PC Both On
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: CC value 0–127 selects preset; recalls with Delay(A) & Reverb(B) engaged. Prefer Program Change when available.

controlChangeCommands.name: PC Rev On
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: CC value 0–127 selects preset; recalls with Reverb(B) engaged. Prefer Program Change when available.
